??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Captain Skarra, trail watch. If you're walking the trails, you're walking them on my watch, so walk them properly. Patrols leave at first light.
    - Windworn Hill and the Long Ridge, both checked. I put a fresh date by each dot. The marks are closer than last season. They always are.
    - You measured them yourself. Wide as a cooking pot and as deep as my wrist. I'll say it once and not again: those tracks frighten me.
    - Out of arrows, cornered by hogs, and not a scratch on him. I could have wrung his neck. I held him so long instead that he complained. Thank you, *Player*.
    - A Trail Watch post at the Old War Camp, in the middle of the Reach. If you'd told me a year ago we'd keep a fire lit out there, I'd have laughed. Dryly.
    - Report.
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* What's on your map?
        - *Choice:* How is Bekk?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - Skarra. I joined the watch at sixteen and never left the rim to adventure; somebody had to stay. Hask made me captain ten years ago, when he was still our chieftain. My patrols see travelers from camp to camp and drive back what comes up from the canyons.
    - I mark every sighting on a hide map in my tent: a red dot and a date. You don't need to see it. Nobody does, except Tavi.
    - Tavi said to show you, so you've seen it. Dots on the high pastures, on the south path, at the far end of the bridge, on the canyon stretch below the rim. Every season they creep closer to town.
    - My son is the fastest climber on the rim, and he knows it. He wants to track whatever raids the high pastures. Not alone. His father tracked a great horned beast alone, thirteen years ago, and did not come home.
    - He came home. He'll go out again, I know that. But he'll go with someone at his back now, and he knows why.
    - Eyes open. Back before dark.
